integrity.proof_basis: exact Gram identities, two-cut optimality inequalities, convexity

scientific_limitations: All integer n>=3, normalized hollow symmetric Monge simplex in the full-matrix Frobenius metric.
Projection formulas apply to the canonical vertex family, not arbitrary interior matrix points.
The metric face is a compact set of path pseudometrics; a closest genuine metric need not exist.
Publication priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact Euclidean projection of Monge corner blocks onto the metric face
